snippet.title: ARC Aquarium - Official Trailer | Every Fish Is a Card
snippet.description:
This isn't a normal aquarium... it's a card game! 🃏🐠
🎮 Play ARC Aquarium on Steam (free demo available): https://store.steampowered.com/app/4213290/ARC_Aquarium/

Every fish, shrimp, seahorse, plant and coral in ARC Aquarium is a collectible card. Open a pack, flip the cards and watch them come alive in your tank.

🃏 Open Freshwater, Reef, Plant, Coral and Gift packs, plus the Rare Deck and Legend Deck, and chase Legendary cards
🐠 Every card comes alive: schools of fish, seahorses, jellyfish and shrimp, each moving in its own way
⭐ Merge duplicate cards all the way up to ★10
💰 Your fish earn gold over time. Collect it, feed your fish and open more packs. No microtransactions
🌙 Decorate up to four tanks with 14 themes, 19 sand colors, day and night mode and 10 lamp colors
🏆 Complete a collection book of 143 species and climb the Steam leaderboards

Try the free demo on Steam, and subscribe to ACA Games for more cozy updates!

More from ACA Games:
⚔️ Quartermark: an idle RPG where your party fights on its own (out now, free demo): https://store.steampowered.com/app/5061040/Quartermark/
🔺 Prismhold: a card-driven tower defense where towers evolve with no cap (out now, free demo): https://store.steampowered.com/app/5421610/Prismhold/

#indiegame #cozygames #cardgame
